- The result is decided by the official Premier League result, then Flashscore, then Sofascore. Only the 90 minutes plus stoppage time count, so a draw resolves "No".

## 2. Current status
- As of 2026-10-17 the match had not been played and nothing settles the question.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-10-17: Chelsea won 2-0 at Everton, with Pedro Neto scoring twice. It was their first away league win under manager Xabi Alonso. Goalkeeper Emi Martínez had a head injury and the concern is concussion, which could keep him out for about 14 days, including this match. Malo Gusto missed the game through illness. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/soccer/match/_/gameId/401878771/chelsea-everton), [Chelsea FC video](https://www.chelseafc.com/en/video/alonso-post-everton-0-2-chelsea-premier-league-2026-27?ssoc=1)

The win ended a four-match winless league run and moved Chelsea to 5th. [Vavel](https://www.vavel.com/en/football/2026/10/10/premier-league/1274721-chelsea-5-1-bournemouth-the-blues-cruise-past-the-cherries.html), [Citizen Digital](https://citizen.digital/article/chelsea-crush-bournemouth-to-end-four-match-winless-run-n391811)

Spurs were still winless (3 draws, 3 losses, 3 points from 6 games), third from bottom. Manager Roberto De Zerbi was among the bookmakers' favourites to be the next manager sacked. [Tribune/AFP](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2634206/spurs-rescue-draw-at-manchester-united), [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/soccer/report/_/gameId/401878773)
- Late Sept 2026: Spurs had their worst start to a Premier League season, including four goalless games. Liverpool knocked them out of the League Cup. Spurs chief executive Venkatesham publicly backed De Zerbi. [theScore](https://www.thescore.com/news/3588190/big-spending-spurs-off-to-historically-bad-start-after-loss-vs-newcastle), [SoccerNews](https://www.soccernews.com/tottenham-chief-venkatesham-backs-de-zerbi-to-turn-things-around/406013/)
- Season context: Chelsea opened with a 3-2 win at Fulham, and their heaviest defeat was 3-0 at Brentford. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49716094/xabi-alonso-wins-chelsea-debut-revamped-front-three-dazzles)

## 4. Base rates
- Chelsea's home record against Spurs is historically very strong. Tottenham's only league win at Stamford Bridge between 1990 and this season was in April 2018. I could not open the rivalry page to confirm the exact numbers. [Wikipedia rivalry](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chelsea_F.C.%E2%80%93Tottenham_Hotspur_F.C._rivalry)
- In the Premier League, home teams generally win about 45% of matches. Strong favourites at roughly 1.6-1.8 decimal odds win about 55-60% of the time, and draws happen about 25% of the time. These are general figures, not sourced to this match.
- Chelsea's league form up to 17 October was uneven: the four-game winless run, then two wins in a row.

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold prices dated on or before 2026-10-17.
- Bookmaker previews (Rotowire, Oddschecker, Sportytrader, Racing Post) were published after the cutoff, so I left them out.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- Chelsea have no midweek game I could find between 17 and 24 October. Their next fixture after this one is a League Cup tie at Liverpool on 28 October. I found no Champions League fixture for them in October. [ESPN fixtures](https://www.espn.com/soccer/team/fixtures/_/id/363/chelsea)
- Tottenham play Coventry on Monday 19 October, which leaves them less rest before this match. That game could also end their winless run or add to the pressure on De Zerbi.
- Things to watch:
  - whether Martínez is cleared after the concussion protocol
  - whether Gusto recovers from illness
  - whether Bentancur's suspension is confirmed
  - any change of manager at Spurs
  - confirmation of the kickoff time

For Yes:
- Chelsea's back-to-back wins on 10 and 17 October, including their first away league win under Alonso.
- Spurs' historically bad start, winless with four goalless games (late September to 10 October).
- Bentancur's likely suspension after his red card on 10 October.

- The strong home head-to-head record.

For No:
- Chelsea were on a four-match winless league run before 10 October, so their form is volatile.
- Emi Martínez is a concussion doubt from 17 October and Gusto was ill.
- London derbies are often tight.
- A Spurs win against Coventry, or a "new manager bounce" if De Zerbi is sacked, could lift Spurs.
- Draws alone take about 25% of outcomes.

**(e) Scenarios**
- No: Spurs beat Coventry, gain confidence and sit deep. Chelsea, with a backup goalkeeper, concede on a counter and the game finishes 1-1.
- Yes: Chelsea's front line (Neto, João Pedro) carries its momentum and breaks down a fragile Spurs side missing Bentancur. Chelsea win 2-0.

**(f) Adjustment**
Starting from about 56%, I adjust in two directions:
- Up slightly for Spurs' poor form, the suspension and their short rest.
- Down slightly for Chelsea's inconsistency, the goalkeeper doubt, derby variance and a possible manager-change bounce.

These roughly offset, so I end at about 56%.

Probability: 56%
